name: n8n Workflow Sanitizer | Hide private credentials

parameters.content:
## Documentation

_Full explanation of what is detected, how to use it and its limitations._

**[README (English)](https://github.com/chrisullua/n8n-workflow-sanitizer/blob/main/README.md)**

**[README (Español)](https://github.com/chrisullua/n8n-workflow-sanitizer/blob/main/README.es.md)**

## 1. Input

_Paste the JSON of the workflow you want to sanitize inside **PUT JSON HERE**, replacing the whole content of the field._

**It currently contains a demo workflow with fake secrets.**

The 'JSON' field must always be in **fixed** mode.

## 2. Detect

_Scans the whole workflow and lists everything that looks private: secret fields, credential, webhook, data table and document IDs, tokens, connection strings and private keys._

**It only lists findings. Nothing is changed here.**

## 3. Redact

_Replaces every finding with a [REDACTED_...] placeholder on a copy of the workflow and clears the pinned data._

**The original is never modified.**

## 4. Download

_Builds a report of what was redacted and converts the sanitized workflow into a downloadable .json file named after the workflow._

**Always review the file before publishing it.**
